# Repository instructions

## Writing documentation

Before finishing any task that creates or edits content under `content/docs/` (or any other
prose meant for readers, such as README files or PR descriptions), apply the `unslop` skill
(`.github/skills/unslop/SKILL.md`) to the text you wrote. Load it explicitly and use it to
edit your draft, since the skill has `disable-model-invocation: true` and will not trigger on
its own.
